name: Korg NAUTILUS Combination
description: Korg NAUTILUS: the timbres, effects and controllers of a combination by SysEx parameter change, read back from the current combination.

sources.title: NAUTILUS MIDI Implementation: Combination, object version 4
sources.notes: Rows read by tools/profiles/korg/read-kronos-table.mjs from SysExDumps/CombiAndSongTimbreSet.txt (sha256 1f54702a26a8284dd9accbb791568a2491a388c977f55ab6f7ebfc9c40c27964) in NAUTILUS_MIDIimp.zip of 2022-09-22, https://www.korg.com/us/support/download/manual/0/873/4923/. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/korg/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/korg/synths/, not this file.

Every row of SysExDumps/CombiAndSongTimbreSet.txt with a parameter id is a parameter, named by its group and its name as printed, and sent by Parameter Change (function 43): F0 42 3g 00 01 5D 43 TYP SOC SUB PID IDX and the value as 21 bits, two's complement, high byte first (*4). Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Left out, the scenes: per group, the rows whose ids Parameter Change also takes for another row: Scene Common, 0 of 39; Scene 1, 0 of 38; Scene 2, 0 of 38; Scene 3, 0 of 38; Scene 4, 0 of 38.
Left out, the step sequencers: per group, the rows whose ids Parameter Change also takes for another row: Step Seq. A, 0 of 836; Step Seq. B, 0 of 836; Step Seq. C, 0 of 836; Step Seq. D, 0 of 836.

A combination: its sixteen timbres, its effects and controllers. The programs its timbres play are edited in Program mode (korg-nautilus). The NAUTILUS takes combination parameters in Combination mode ("Which parameters are currently available for editing depends on the instrument's mode"). The effects' own parameters, which depend on the effect type (Effect.txt), are not here.

A range whose first value is the larger (9D~63) is two's complement over its bytes, -99~+99. A choice is a row naming both of two values. The value column is 19 characters wide; a name it cuts short keeps its cut, with an ellipsis. Other value names are in each parameter's description.
3 rows with an id print a fixed value (`10(fixed)`, `00(fixed)`: Insert Effect11 Chain To; Insert Effect12 Chain Switch; Insert Effect12 Chain To; …) and are not settings.

Left out: 23 settings (Insert Effect1 Chain Switch; Insert Effect1 Chain To; Insert Effect2 Chain Switch; Insert Effect2 Chain To; Insert Effect3 Chain Switch; Insert Effect3 Chain To; …): shares its parameter id with Chain To (`* Chain To`), and the archive does not say which value of it turns the chain off.

Left out: 191 settings (Scene Common Scene Select; Scene Common Cue Mode; Scene Common Latch Switch; Scene Common Arp Switch; Scene Common Drum Switch; Scene Common Tempo; …): the scenes' rows (their arpeggiator and drum track settings among them) have ids unique under Parameter Change (43), Scene Parameter Change (6D) and Arp/Drum Track Parameter Change (6E) alike, and the archive names no message for them.

Left out: 3344 settings (Step Seq. A Resolution; Step Seq. A Accent Knob; Step Seq. A Length; Step Seq. A Steps per Beat; Step Seq. A Step 1 Tone; Step Seq. A Step 1 Accent; …): the step sequencers' ids are unique under Parameter Change (43) and under Arp/Drum Track Parameter Change (6E) alike, and the archive does not say which message they go by.
Left out: 4 settings (Step Seq. A (offset 1386); Step Seq. B (offset 1650); Step Seq. C (offset 1914); Step Seq. D (offset 2178)): printed with a group and no name.

Left out: 528 settings (Timbre1 Knob1 Assign; Timbre1 Knob2 Assign; Timbre1 Knob3 Assign; Timbre1 Knob4 Assign; Timbre1 Knob5 Assign; Timbre1 Knob6 Assign; …): its parameter change takes SUB from the value (`SUB = (Assign >> 7) & 0x01, Value = Assign & 0x7f`), which one message template cannot.

Pull: Current Object Dump Request (function 74) for object 01, the combination, answered by a Current Object Dump (function 75) carrying object version 4 and 5640 bytes in Korg's 8-in-7 packing (*3: 6446 bytes). 1855 parameters are read back at their rows' offsets and bits. A dump of any other length does not match.

Sent and not read back: 578 settings (Effect LFO1 BPM; Effect LFO2 BPM; Timbre1 Detune; Timbre1 Delay Time; Timbre1 Swing; Timbre1 Knob1 Value; …): a value over two bytes, whose byte order the archive does not say.
The exclusive header carries the global MIDI channel as 3g; the profile's deviceId variable is that byte, 30H for channel 1.

Identity: the Device Inquiry reply (NAUTILUS_MIDI_MIDI_Implentaion.txt) is printed F0 7E 0g 06 02 42 00 01 5D 00 mm 00 vv ww xx 00 F7, 17 bytes where the universal reply has 15. Its 7th to 10th bytes, 00 01 5D 00, are checked as printed, where the universal reply puts the family and member code; its 11th byte, mm, is one per model and is not checked: NAUTILUS 61Keys 05H, NAUTILUS 73Keys 0EH, NAUTILUS 88Keys 17H.

Preset recall: Bank Select MSB and LSB, then Program Change, for the 14 banks the implementation's receive table gives in Combination mode when Global's Bank Map is KORG (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N). With Bank Map GM(2) the MSBs differ, and this recall does not apply.
